title: Bit of a letdown
text:
I hunted for a subscription box service for my honeschooled 9 year old that would give him some screen free entertainment and learning outside of our usual routine. I watched several youtube videos of several STEM boxes before deciding to purchase this one, primarily sold on it based on the fact that it was discounted, and I felt it was a low-risk way to see how we felt about it before committing to a full year.

The box arrived ahead of schedule, which was exciting, but was already smaller than anticipated, because all of the unboxing videos and advertisements showed this kit coming in a durable tin lunchbox style case, and advertised that the first box would include a canvas bag... not a huge let down, but misleading and also detracts from the overall calue of the contents.

Upon opening the box, my kid and I were both underwhelmed. Included was a booklet describing the contents, the "Who Was" series book about Frank Lloyd Wright, a black and white postcard, which was ripped on one edge, 3 Wonder Crate Heroes cards, and a sample of a construction toy kit that was simple cardboard shapes and plastic clips. I paid $22 (at a discount) , and recieved a $6 book, $1 worth of trading cards, a 50c postcard and what amounts to at most, a $3 craft kit.

I will not be continuing my subscription.
label: neutral
